instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file and use the existing open B-spline sketch as the pipe path. Create a circular profile sketch with radius 1.5 mm at the left endpoint of the path, then create a solid Part Design Additive Pipe by sweeping that circle along the B-spline path. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
